computerUse.title: Computer Use
computerUse.description: Let agents capture and control this computer's primary display using the bundled local driver.
computerUse.warning: Off by default. Enabling gives agents desktop control. Disabling stops the driver and removes the computer tool. Gateway configuration may reload and interrupt active work.
computerUse.off: Disabled. Agents cannot use the computer tool.
computerUse.unavailable: Enabled, but the driver is unavailable. Check permissions and the bundled driver, then turn this off and on to retry.
computerUse.unsupported: Requires macOS 13+ (Intel or Apple silicon), or Windows 10+ x64.
computerUse.permissionHint: These statuses are read-only. Only the button below requests permissions. If denied, allow ClawX in System Settings > Privacy & Security; macOS may require restarting ClawX. Turning this feature off does not revoke OS grants.
computerUse.error: Could not complete the operation. Refresh the status and retry; see application logs for details.

gateway.notRunningDesc: The OpenClaw Gateway needs to be running to use this feature. It will start automatically, or you can start it from Settings.
